content.value: · A parallel résonant circuit has a capacitance of 100 pF in one branch and inductance (10) of 100 μH plus a resistance of 10Ω in parallel branch. If the supply voltage is 10V, calculate (i) resonance frequency, (ii) impedance of the circuit and line current at resonance.
